defects: (a) THE SEAT`S: A CR LF CHECK THAT WAS NOT A GATE. At step zero`s commit the line-ending check printed data/b645_ferry_scan.txt as CR LF and did not exit non-zero, so the chain committed it; the blob is LF (relay`s eol=lf), the working file rewritten LF after; from then on every commit passed a gate that exits 1 on a CR LF file.

(b) THE SEAT`S: A STREAM EDIT OF AN UNSEALED TOOL. Two call sites in tools/b645_record.py (the proved_by argument) were changed by sed -i, against the ferry`s line that edits to unsealed tools go through the Edit tool -- b644`s defect (a) repeated; the change was the one intended, both lines printed after.
(c) THE SEAT`S: A DELETE NOT IN THE HOUSE FORM. sed`s backup file tools/b645_record.py.bak, untracked and just written, was removed by rm on a relative path, not on a verified absolute path.

(d) THE SEAT`S: THE READERS` BRIEF DEFINED `established` TOO WIDELY. It read "stated as true, proved, verified or compiled", and a monograph states its own arguments plainly, so the helper readers marked nearly every argued, interpretive or classical sentence `established`, which the mapping reads OVERREACHES; the seat`s stated-as rule (relay data/b645_table_monograph.txt) moved 489 such rows to `graded` where the quote claims no status beyond argument and the reason names no corpus fact it conflicts with, and every row still non-MATCHES was read whole.

(e) THE SEAT`S: THE BRIEF`S F5 NAMED ONE OF TWO THEOREMS. SIDE-kernel declares two theorems called structural_exhaustiveness_proved: ConservationBridge`s takes ConservationHypothesis, TheBridgeComplete`s (Bridge/TheBridgeComplete.lean :249) is unconditional; the brief and the map`s rows :52, :75 and :124 read the first alone. Found by a helper reader`s note; the map re-banked (relay ab51c4df, its verdicts unmoved, three LICENSED cells and two re-cuts corrected) and the readers` Route 1 rows corrected by hand. The terminal table resolves the bare name to ConservationBridge`s file, a note for the author.

(f) THE HELPER READERS`: THREE DEVIATIONS FROM THE BRIEF. Two readers wrote their file twice (an Edit after the Write, adding missed heading lines); one wrote two scratch scripts in the scratchpad (c11_gen.py, c11_out.txt) and its file CR LF; all in the scratchpad, none in a repository, the records unchanged by any of it.

(g) THE SEAT`S: THE GENERALISED READER COULD NOT SEE ITS FOUNDING CASE. Its first shape (D1, D2) read every docstring MATCHES and its positive control -- PlateauRamp`s header at v0.25, the case it generalises -- MATCHES; the Mathlib-scope rule (D5) and the proved-Prop rule (D6) were added with planted cases before the bank, and the control is flagged in it.

(h) THE SEAT`S: TOOLING MISSES BEFORE ANY BANK. The process listing`s tab escape in single quotes; the map`s per-document counts parsed from the wrong columns (the instrument refused the cite); the map`s paragraph rule missing claim paragraphs; the D4 rule reading a statement not read; the outsider retirement matcher`s two loose forms; the phase column read from the REGISTRY heading, the ruling`s word being the phase directory -- each repaired before its bank was committed.
(i) THE ACT`S: THE FERRY`S tools/b628_intake.py IS NO FILE. The intake form lives in tools/b628_record.py (`intake`) and tools/b628_worklist.py; read there and cited (relay data/b645_reads.txt).

(j) THE SEAT`S: THE STEP-ZERO CENSUSES AND PINS RAN LATE. The handoff census, the faces census and the pins were not run at step zero; the lock gate`s records named them and they were run after Component 6, before the seal (data/b645_census_stepzero.txt, data/b645_faces_census_stepzero.txt, data/b645_pins_stepzero.txt, none missing, none hard-failing) -- b644`s defect (g) repeated; the face`s section (0) declares it.

(k) THE SEAT`S: A BACKTICK STANDING AS AN APOSTROPHE IN A SEALED TOOL`S TEXT. The record tool`s list of readings for the author`s strike (FOR_AUTHOR) writes "the outsiders` readings", a backtick before a space that the possessive repair does not reach, and the guarded append refused the trail for it; the sealed tool left unedited, the trail was appended by a script beside it through the same guarded append, from the tool`s own text with that one character set as an apostrophe (’), and its bank written as the tool writes it.
